description: Shared Renovate preset for SP Night port repositories. A port extends this and gets engine bumps for free.

customManagers.description: The engine version a port's mapping is written against, declared in its template frontmatter. Renovate does not know what a .tmpl is, so it is matched explicitly — this is what turns one engine release into one PR per port.

packageRules.description: An engine bump changes what the theme files render to, so it must never merge unreviewed.
GitHub Actions are infrastructure, not the theme. Group and automerge the minors.
